The mechanisms and code locations match the described vulnerability: both highlight that operatorFeeAmount (the accumulated but not-yet-withdrawn fee) is not handled properly in totalAssets(), leading to incorrect valuation and potential user losses (especially for late depositors or withdrawers). The report even references the relevant ERC4626 standard clause for correct totalAssets() accounting regarding fees. Therefore, the report did detect the specific vulnerability outlined in the description.
